title: Every gate add command a worker is given names a --do per option: the brief's fixed rules and the role file's blocking-gate bullet
goal: bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES' gate add command and agents/worker.md rule 6's blocking-gate bullet name a --do OPTION=ID per option, and the provisional bullet's reason names the blocking case check warns of, so a worker's blocking gate is never added without its do map (SP-hlt2tdel review gap 7; ST-oc7hsriu's worker added g1 with no do from the brief in this sprint)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_dispatch as d;t=' '.join(r if isinstance(r,str) else ' '.join(r) for r in d.WORKER_RULES);ls=[l for l in open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8') if 'gate add ID --kind blocking' in l];sys.exit(0 if 'gate add' in t and '--do' in t and ls and all('--do' in l for l in ls) else 1)

notes: The check reads a role-file line holding 'gate add ID --kind blocking': the blocking bullet (agents/worker.md rule 6, second sub-bullet) has no command today, so the work gives it one in that form.
